title: Judged replay hits of one cell v1
description: `<cell>/hits_judged.json`, written by `repo hits judge` (docs/repo-evaluation-contract.md §4.5, §9): a judge model's label of each credited (thread, finding) pair of one `dokimi:review_replay` cell, read with the thread's full comment from the task's gold file and the finding's full text from the cell's `answer.txt`. Only credited pairs are rescored, so `recall_judged` <= `recall`. The grade is not changed.

cell.description: The cell's directory name in the batch.

model.description: The cell's answer model, as `result.json` records it.

pairs.description: One entry per credited pair of `grade.json` `details.matches`, in its order.

thread.description: The gold thread's `id` (a string or an integer), as the match records it.

finding.description: The finding's index among the answer's objects, as the match records it.

reason.description: The judge's one sentence; `null` when unjudged.

error.description: Why the pair is unjudged: its full text was not found, or no judge reply parsed.

counts.description: The pairs per label; `unjudged` counts the pairs with `label` null.

n_threads.description: The task's gold threads, from `grade.json` `metrics.n_threads`; `null` when it records none.

recall_judged.description: `same point` pairs over `n_threads`, rounded to 3 places; `null` when `n_threads` is 0 or `null`.
